# PricingHub

> Job costing for contractors, as a spreadsheet. 24 connected sheets in Excel and
> Google Sheets: estimate, proposal, schedule, crew hours, change orders, invoices,
> and a dashboard of budget against actual. No subscription, no add-ins, no macros.

One page of static HTML. The margin calculator on the page runs in the browser.

## On this page

- [Profit check](https://pricing-hub-seven.vercel.app/#calc): type a job and see the margin before you quote it.
- [What it does](https://pricing-hub-seven.vercel.app/#what): the 24 sheets and how they connect.
- [First ten minutes](https://pricing-hub-seven.vercel.app/#start): the setup order.
- [Tour](https://pricing-hub-seven.vercel.app/#tour): each sheet, with a screenshot.
- [Fit check](https://pricing-hub-seven.vercel.app/#fit): who it suits and who it does not.
- [FAQ](https://pricing-hub-seven.vercel.app/#faq)
